mapper.select: SELECT asub.id, asub.student_id AS studentId, u.name AS studentName, asub.content AS content, asub.submission_date AS submissionDate, asub.is_late AS isLate, asub.late_penalty AS latePenalty, asub.score, asub.teacher_comment AS teacherComment, asub.graded FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN users u ON asub.student_id = u.id WHERE asub.assignment_id = #{assignmentId}

SELECT DISTINCT a.id, a.title, a.description, a.course_id AS courseId, a.due_date AS dueDate, a.publish_date AS publishDate, a.is_active AS isActive, a.teacher_id AS teacherId, a.max_score AS maxScore, a.submission_count AS submissionCount, a.graded_count AS gradedCount, a.status FROM assignments a JOIN assignment_classes ac ON a.id = ac.assignment_id JOIN class_students cs ON ac.class_id = cs.class_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId}
